description: Machine-readable reconciliation state for migrations observed applied on production (wyyuqfdxucjksghsmhry) that have no equivalent in the staging baseline. Consumed by security/release/production-eligibility.js. While overallStatus is not RESOLVED, production promotion fails closed. This file records EVIDENCE and OPEN QUESTIONS; it does not resolve anything on the owner's behalf.
observationMethod: Read-only Supabase Management API list_migrations against both projects, reconciled by migration NAME (this repo's deploy tool stamps its own apply-time version, so filename timestamps are not reliable join keys - see the ledger-naming note in docs/release/PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION.md).
productionLedgerCaveat: Production's supabase_migrations.schema_migrations table is known to contain at least two placeholder statement entries (documented in docs/security/batch0-migration-source-restoration.md). An entry appearing in the ledger therefore proves an entry was recorded, NOT that the recorded DDL is what actually ran. Do not treat ledger presence as authoritative provenance.

records.name: shared_room_item_contributions

repoEquivalent.evidenceMethod: present in the deferred-migrations quarantine directory on staging/production-parity

stagingEquivalent.reason: deliberately deferred, never applied to staging

records.requiredDecision: Owner decision required, and this one cannot be resolved by a forward-port alone. supabase/migrations-deferred/README.md states this migration 'is not applied in production' and defers it precisely BECAUSE production defined three dressing_room_items RLS policies differently. Production has since applied a migration of this name (20260808201806), so the README's stated premise is now false. Required: (1) re-verify production's CURRENT dressing_room_items policy set and created_by column against the deferred file, (2) determine whether what production applied is semantically the same migration or a divergent variant, (3) then either promote the deferred file, replace it with production's actual applied form, or re-document the deferral on accurate grounds.
records.notes: This is the sharpest reconciliation item and the reason PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED exists as a machine-enforced state. The deferred file is not merely un-promoted - its recorded justification is contradicted by live production state, so the repository's own documentation cannot currently be trusted on this object. Resolving it requires a read-only production schema comparison that Phase 2A deliberately did not perform (Phase 2A is a control-plane phase, not a production-audit phase).

resolutionRule: overallStatus may only become RESOLVED when every record has a semanticStatus in [EQUIVALENT, SUPERSEDED, PRODUCTION_ONLY_INTENTIONAL] AND a provenanceStatus in [RESOLVED, WAIVED_BY_OWNER], with the waiver recorded in docs/release/PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION.md. No automation may set RESOLVED.
